```
def length(locations: List['Location']=[], _3d: bool=False) ->float:
    if not locations or len(locations) < 2:
        return 0.0
    
    total_length = 0.0
    for i in range(len(locations) - 1):
        loc1 = locations[i]
        loc2 = locations[i + 1]
        
        distance = None
        if _3d and loc1.has_elevation() and loc2.has_elevation():
            distance = loc1.distance_3d(loc2)
        else:
            distance = loc1.distance_2d(loc2)
        
        if distance is not None:
            total_length += distance
    
    return total_length
```
